==========================================
Unnamed unscoped enum with a fixed underlying type
==========================================

enum : unsigned short { A = 2 };

---

(translation_unit
  (enum_specifier
    (sized_type_specifier)
    (enumerator_list
      (enumerator
        (identifier)
        (number_literal)))))

==========================================
Unnamed unscoped enum with an int base
==========================================

---

(translation_unit
  (enum_specifier
    (primitive_type)
    (enumerator_list
      (enumerator
        (identifier)))))

==========================================

      (enumerator
        (identifier)))))

==========================================
Unnamed bit-fields
==========================================

struct S { unsigned : 0; int x; };
struct T { int a : 3; int : 5; int b : 2; };

---

(translation_unit
  (struct_specifier
    (type_identifier)
    (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        (sized_type_specifier)
        (bitfield_clause
          (number_literal)))
      (field_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (field_identifier))))
  (struct_specifier
    (type_identifier)
    (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (field_identifier)
        (bitfield_clause
          (number_literal)))
      (field_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (bitfield_clause
          (number_literal)))
      (field_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (field_identifier)
        (bitfield_clause
          (number_literal))))))

          (number_literal))))))

==========================================
Initializer with a call on member access
==========================================

struct V { const char *get_str() const; };
void f(V v) {
  const char *s(v.get_str());
  const char &r(v.x);
}

---

(translation_unit
  (struct_specifier
    (type_identifier)
    (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        (type_qualifier)
        (primitive_type)
        (pointer_declarator
          (function_declarator
            (field_identifier)
            (parameter_list)
            (type_qualifier))))))
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (type_identifier)
          (identifier))))
    (compound_statement
      (declaration
        (type_qualifier)
        (primitive_type)
        (init_declarator
          (pointer_declarator
            (identifier))
          (argument_list
            (call_expression
              (field_expression
                (identifier)
                (field_identifier))
              (argument_list)))))
      (declaration
        (type_qualifier)
        (primitive_type)
        (init_declarator
          (reference_declarator
            (identifier))
          (argument_list
            (field_expression
              (identifier)
              (field_identifier))))))))

==========================================
Explicit instantiation of a class template
==========================================

template <class T> struct C { T t; };
template class C<int>;
extern template class C<long>;
template struct C<char>;

---

(translation_unit
  (template_declaration
    (template_parameter_list
      (type_parameter_declaration
        (type_identifier)))
    (struct_specifier
      (type_identifier)
      (field_declaration_list
        (field_declaration
          (type_identifier)
          (field_identifier)))))
  (template_instantiation
    (class_specifier
      (template_type
        (type_identifier)
        (template_argument_list
          (type_descriptor
            (primitive_type))))))
  (template_instantiation
    (class_specifier
      (template_type
        (type_identifier)
        (template_argument_list
          (type_descriptor
            (sized_type_specifier))))))
  (template_instantiation
    (struct_specifier
      (template_type
        (type_identifier)
        (template_argument_list
          (type_descriptor
            (primitive_type)))))))

==========================================
Braced default argument
==========================================

void f(int x = {}) {}
struct P { int a; int b; };
void h(P p = {1, 2}, int y = {3}) {}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (optional_parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type)
          (identifier)
          (initializer_list))))
    (compound_statement))
  (struct_specifier
    (type_identifier)
    (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (field_identifier))
      (field_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (field_identifier))))
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (optional_parameter_declaration
          (type_identifier)
          (identifier)
          (initializer_list
            (number_literal)
            (number_literal)))
        (optional_parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type)
          (identifier)
          (initializer_list
            (number_literal)))))
    (compound_statement)))

==========================================
Deleted free operator
==========================================

struct A {};
struct B {};
bool operator==(A a, B b) = delete;

---

(translation_unit
  (struct_specifier
    (type_identifier)
    (field_declaration_list))
  (struct_specifier
    (type_identifier)
    (field_declaration_list))
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (operator_name)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (type_identifier)
          (identifier))
        (parameter_declaration
          (type_identifier)
          (identifier))))
    (delete_method_clause)))

==========================================
Deleted and defaulted members and friends (control)
==========================================

struct D {
  bool operator!=(const D &) const = delete;
  D &operator=(const D &) = delete;
  friend bool operator<(D, D) = default;
};

---

(translation_unit
  (struct_specifier
    (type_identifier)
    (field_declaration_list
      (function_definition
        (primitive_type)
        (function_declarator
          (operator_name)
          (parameter_list
            (parameter_declaration
              (type_qualifier)
              (type_identifier)
              (abstract_reference_declarator)))
          (type_qualifier))
        (delete_method_clause))
      (function_definition
        (type_identifier)
        (reference_declarator
          (function_declarator
            (operator_name)
            (parameter_list
              (parameter_declaration
                (type_qualifier)
                (type_identifier)
                (abstract_reference_declarator)))))
        (delete_method_clause))
      (friend_declaration
        (declaration
          (primitive_type)
          (init_declarator
            (function_declarator
              (operator_name)
              (parameter_list
                (parameter_declaration
                  (type_identifier))
                (parameter_declaration
                  (type_identifier))))
            (identifier)))))))
